contract.metadataSource: Existing frozen V3 COIN-M contract specification; contractSize is 100 USD.

dataSource: Binance Vision official COIN-M monthly archives

assumptions.crashClusterDefinition: BTCUSD_PERP execution daily OR BTCUSD Index daily close-to-close return <= -5% OR daily low/open <= -5%; crash days with at most one non-crash calendar day gap are one cluster.
assumptions.parameterFreeze: V2 curve_mild and curve_aggressive definitions reused without retuning.
assumptions.fillLevelPnl: Lot mark-to-market plus lot funding PnL from actual fill until lot reduction/end; fees and slippage reported separately.
assumptions.leaveOneCrashOut: Every requested removal reruns the complete dynamic simulator with the cluster orders disabled at their first crossing.

rules.robustBroad: Both curve variants are positive in at least 2 of 3 calendar years, remain positive after removing their top 5 crash clusters, and top-5 removed impact is less than 50% of total OOS ending-BTC delta.
rules.robustCrashAlpha: Full OOS delta is positive and top-3 removal does not erase it, but the broad rule fails.
rules.fragile: Top-3 removal erases the advantage, or the available-Funding advantage disappears when Funding is excluded.
rules.invalid: A future-function, duplicate-MTM, execution-path, or unhandled data-alignment validation check fails.

v32Readiness.reason: The result is crash-concentrated rather than broad; keep it research-only.
